name: Toskhowwl VI
description: Toskhowwl VI was a planet located within the Toskhowwl system of the Mid Rim. Around 5 ABY, the Jaltiri tribals lived on Toskhowwl VI and were known beyond their world for their custom of building stacks of severed heads.
lead_paragraphs: Toskhowwl VI was a planet located within the Toskhowwl system of the Mid Rim. Around 5 ABY, the Jaltiri tribals lived on Toskhowwl VI and were known beyond their world for their custom of building stacks of severed heads.
